Cluster-to-Logits for frequency 0

For each logit, the first plot shows the normal heatmap, the second plot is remapped by frequency multiplication (new_a = (freq * a) mod p, new_b = (freq * b) mod p), and the third plot is remapped by the modular inverse (if available).

Immediately below are three neurons from the cluster, and their DFT's to help make sense of what is going on.

No neurons with max preactivation >= 0.09 found for DFT plotting.
